description: A three-rung CI fixture in the SNB Interactive v1 CSV shape. sf0 passes; sf1 has one query that fails at runtime and one deliberately wrong reference answer, so it fails typed with both recorded; sf2 is never attempted. archives/ is built from source/ with: tar --zstd --sort=name --mtime=@0 --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --mode=u+rw,go+r-w -cf archives/rung-fixture-sfN.tar.zst -C source/sfN social_network
variance_line: Read-only fixture queries over the bulk-load snapshot; the update stream is refused.
attribution: Data shape from the LDBC Social Network Benchmark (https://ldbcouncil.org/benchmarks/snb/), used under CC-BY 4.0.
